profiles.name: Jakobm90
profiles.profile: This is the kind of card that makes you squint and ask whether the big stick is sabotaging the whole operation. The driver has been all gas, no steering wheel, and the approach play hasn’t exactly rushed in to save the day either. There is at least a pulse around the greens, which is why the rounds aren’t somehow even uglier, but the shape here is still mostly self-inflicted chaos. The weird part is the profile is not totally dead — just volatile enough to convince you he’s one decent swing thought away from either a breakout or another full-blown range fire.
